payload.title: Gherkin: features_backend/idea-context-packs.feature
payload.description: Narrative, complete feature covering: a thread that lights up yields one pack and up to three ideas each citing two References; a concept whose accepts are at its own baseline yields no pack; an anchor already drafted yields nothing without new evidence; a site with no Messages still gets acceptance packs; pending References appear as context and are never cited; every idea sits in the Idea stage and passed the gate; a pack states its date basis; single-item ideas are ranked by signals. Steps in features_backend/steps/. Can be written first and drive S1.3-S1.7.
